clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within eighteen months: your mother lying awake over money in March 1988, the two of you stopping talk about it by May 1988, your brother's grades falling in November 1989 a few months after the death, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in your parents' distance over money and your brother's functioning fall on either side of the death, suggesting the family's balance shifted around that time.

clusters.name: Your mother's breast cancer diagnosis, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother's diagnosis in February 1995, within two years: you left home for college in September 1993, migraines kept you in bed by March 1994, you called your brother most nights by April 1994, you stopped returning his calls by June 1995 about four months after her diagnosis, and you stopped calling home by February 1996. Your symptom rose and your moves toward and away from your brother bracket the diagnosis, with distance opening between you and your mother as the period settles.
